skills.detail:
When the Enemy Has a Treasure Area:
Moves to the enemy's Treasure Area which is furthest from the user. A mid-range area attack.

When the Enemy Has No Treasure Area:
A mid-range area attack.

Damage dealt will disregard damage reduction. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time. Acquires SPD debuff effect at Level 5.
There is a cooldown in effect for a set period of time at the start of battle.
skills.name: Conqueror of Three Worlds Ragnaraku

skills.detail: A long-range area attack with a Knockback effect and a chance to inflict Recovery Block. When dealing damage to an enemy with 70% or more of their max HP remaining, deals an additional amount of fixed damage. This will deal a fixed amount of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit. Become temporarily invincible after use.
